calibration.scenario: steady_noise base plant, no jitter, one fixed replica
calibration.capacityMetric: mean observed cache-missed input plus output TPS over active 10-second windows
calibration.latencyBounds: maximum observed TTFT and maximum per-request maximum ITL, including failed requests with a first token

candidate.invalidSampleAction: clear evidence and restore seed; warming samples preserve consecutive count
candidate.timestampWatermark: monotone; old rejected samples do not replace timestamp or membership baseline
candidate.storage: one timestamp, ready count and consecutive count per test arm; fresh instance per run

sensitivity.interpretation: multiply measured unheadroom seed; effective capacity also includes 0.75 headroom
sensitivity.reference: static manual 300 tokens per second for reference cost/excess; matched static resolved seed for paired tolerance gates, same startup and quota
sensitivity.excess: positive integral of ready replicas minus paired manual ready replicas; not an optimal oracle

limitations: Test-only candidate. No production online policy or Auto API.
Sampler exposes only shortest window, no aligned per-replica window boundaries or latency counts.
No request-length distribution or saturation certificate is available to the candidate.
Resolved base seed is deliberately transferred to heldout engines and workload shapes; this does not establish production Catalog eligibility.
